FUNCTION_BLOCK FB

    pushEn : BOOL;
    pushItem : INT;
    popEn : BOOL;
END_VAR

    count : INT;

    empty : BOOL;
    head : INT;

    fifo : ARRAY[1..8] OF INT;

VAR

    prevPop : BOOL := FALSE;
    prevCount : INT := 0;
    oldF : ARRAY[1..8] OF INT;
    newArr : ARRAY[1..8] OF INT;
    risingPush : BOOL;
    risingPop : BOOL;
    popAct : BOOL;
    pushAct : BOOL;
    afterPopCount : INT;
    newCount : INT;
    i : INT;

risingPush := pushEn AND NOT prevPush;
risingPop := popEn AND NOT prevPop;

    oldF[i] := fifo[i];

popAct := risingPop AND (prevCount > 0);

    afterPopCount := prevCount - 1;
ELSE
    afterPopCount := prevCount;
END_IF

pushAct := risingPush AND (afterPopCount < 8);

IF pushAct THEN
    newCount := afterPopCount + 1;
ELSE
    newCount := afterPopCount;
END_IF

FOR i := 1 TO 8 DO
    newArr[i] := 0;

IF popAct THEN

            newArr[i] := oldF[i + 1];

    ELSE

END_IF

count := newCount;
full := (newCount = 8);
empty := (newCount = 0);

prevPush := pushEn;
prevPop := popEn;
prevCount := newCount;
